question: Who was announced as the best male athlete in 36th National Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sajan Prakash__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sajan Prakash** was announced as the best male athlete at the 36th National Games 2022.
 
• He is a renowned **Indian swimmer** known for his exceptional skills in the water.
 
• Sajan Prakash made history by becoming the **first Indian swimmer** to qualify for the Olympic Games through the 'A' standard time in swimming.
 
• His achievements have significantly contributed to elevating the status of Indian swimming on the global stage.
